description: Real GDELT 2.0 files. data.gdeltproject.org has no robots.txt (404) and no rate limit was met at one request every 2 seconds.
terms_note: Read on 2026-09-30 at https://www.gdeltproject.org/about.html: all datasets are available for unlimited and unrestricted use, including commercial use, without fee; they may be redistributed and republished; any use or redistribution must cite the GDELT Project and link to its website. Not legally reviewed. The plan uses only URLs and event metadata.
fips_reminder: GDELT geographic country codes are FIPS 10-4: NI is Nigeria and NG is Niger. Actor country codes are CAMEO (NGA).
columns_used_by_the_counts: export (0-based): ActionGeo_CountryCode 53, Actor1CountryCode 7, Actor2CountryCode 17, Actor1Geo_CountryCode 37, Actor2Geo_CountryCode 44.

files.note: The http:// URLs it lists redirect (301) to https://. The adapter must follow or upgrade them.
Events, 61 tab-separated columns, no header. Newest 15-minute slice when fetched.

Events slice chosen because it holds 7 rows where Actor1Geo_CountryCode (col 37) or Actor2Geo_CountryCode (col 44) is NG, which is Niger in FIPS 10-4 (Nigeria is NI), for the FIPS test the plan asks for. Their actors are BFA/NER, not NGA, and their ActionGeo country is not NI, so a correct filter rejects them. No ActionGeo_CountryCode NG row turned up in the 10 slices examined (15:45 to 18:00 UTC).
DERIVED: the first 12 lines of the 18:00 UTC slice's GKG 2.1 file (27 columns, no header) whose V2Locations mention Nigeria. The full file (6.9 MB zipped, 1,664 rows) is not stored.
